title: Monotonic Stack Introduction Quiz
description: A quick check to review the basic idea of monotonic stack.

questions.question: What does a monotonic stack often help solve?

options.text: Next greater or next smaller element problems

questions.explanation: Monotonic stacks are commonly used for next greater and next smaller element problems.

questions.question: What is the output of the following code?
questions.codeSnippet:
numbers = [2, 1, 3]
result = [-1] * len(numbers)
stack = []

for i in range(len(numbers)):
    while stack and numbers[i] > numbers[stack[-1]]:
        index = stack.pop()
        result[index] = numbers[i]
    stack.append(i)

print(result)
questions.explanation: The next greater value for 2 is 3, for 1 is 3, and 3 has no greater value to its right.
